reviewer: Unblinded implementation assistant; no paid judge or clinician adjudication
search_policy: Autonomous; no-search is a policy observation, not an automatic medical/retrieval error

query_ratings.appropriate: Targets the case, population/outcome or correct named study
query_ratings.partially_appropriate: Related but misses a decisive aspect or uses restrictive/confusing terms
query_ratings.inappropriate: Targets an unrelated or incorrect question/study

paper_relevance.directly_relevant: Returned title/visible text addresses the decisive clinical topic or requested original trial
paper_relevance.partially_relevant: Related topic but limited matching population, outcome, article type or available detail

citation_support.supported: Actual model-visible text substantiates the cited factual claim
citation_support.partially_supported: Some claim content is supported but detail/extent exceeds the view
citation_support.unsupported: Claim conflicts with or is absent from cited visible text

limits: Nonexclusive evaluator reference examples; no exhaustive recall/full-text claim. Model reading means supplied visible text, not hidden host-fetched abstract. Score keys remain unchanged. Report answer appraisal separately.
